title: Choosing Between Box Pin And Pin New
prompt: When should you use `Box::pin` instead of `Pin::new` on an async block or future?
answer: `Pin::new` requires the wrapped type to implement `Unpin`, which promises the type can safely move. Most compiler-generated async blocks are `!Unpin` because they contain self-references across await points. `Box::pin` allocates the future on the heap and safely pins `!Unpin` types without requiring unsafe code.
